step1_analysis.circuit_type: Continuous-Time FIR Filter Tap / Delay Cell
step1_analysis.description: A PMOS common-source amplifier with a diode-connected PMOS load, representing one half of a pseudo-differential delay cell. It acts as a first-order low-pass filter to provide a tunable fractional delay for a continuous-time FIR equalizer.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS 0.25-m Continuous-Time FIR Filter With 125 ps per Tap Delay as a Fractionally Spaced Receiver Equalizer for 1-Gb/s Data Transmission

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the delay cell.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm2 / gm1. Since XM1 and XM2 have identical W/L and similar bias currents, gm1 ≈ gm2, yielding a gain of ~1 V/V or 0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the ratio of transconductances of the input and load PMOS devices.

bandwidth.description: -3dB bandwidth of the low-pass filter tap.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = gm1 / (2 * pi * Cload). With gm1 ≈ 240uS and an assumed 50fF load, BW ≈ 760 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is tunable via bias current (which changes gm1) and depends heavily on the load capacitance.

group_delay.description: Propagation delay through the filter tap.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ≈ Cload / gm1. With 50fF load and 240uS gm1, delay ≈ 208 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's tunable delay range. Adjusted by changing the bias current.

power_consumption.description: DC power dissipation of the single tap half-circuit.

sky130_expected.reasoning: A single half-tap consumes a fraction of the total 45mW reported for the entire 6-tap differential filter.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, -3dB bandwidth, group delay, and power consumption of the FIR filter tap.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Continuous-Time FIR Filter Tap Delay Cell
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u

XM1 OUT_MINUS OUT_MINUS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUT_MINUS IN_PLUS VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIN_PLUS IN_PLUS 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 100MEG 0 0)

* Bias current sink to ground to enable operation
Ibias OUT_MINUS 0 115u
* Load capacitance to set bandwidth and delay
Cload OUT_MINUS 0 50f

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1MEG 10G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT_MINUS)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1MEG
let gain_db_3db = dc_gain - 3
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_db_3db fall=1

* Calculate group delay from phase derivative
let phase_rad = cph(v(OUT_MINUS))
let group_delay = -1 * deriv(phase_rad) / (2 * 3.14159265359)
meas ac delay_100M find group_delay at=100MEG

tran 10p 30n
meas tran t_in trig v(IN_PLUS) val=0.9 rise=2
meas tran t_out trig v(OUT_MINUS) val=0.9 fall=2
let delay_tran = t_out - t_in
print delay_tran

quit
.endc
